data.name: Idelson
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Ides' which means 'to split' or 'to divide'. The suffix '-son' denotes 'son'. In Roman mythology, the Ides of March was a significant religious day, celebrated in the honor of the god Jupiter. This name is therefore a tribute to the ancient Roman tradition and the power and wisdom of Jupiter.
